response.original_title: Kids Drink Ocean Water.... INSTANTLY REGRET IT
response.overview: Two high-schoolers decide the ocean is basically free Gatorade. One sip later, the experiment is over and the regret is immediate. They still have to make it through the school day. One keeps the big grin and pretends nothing is happening. The other is at his desk, braces flashing, both hands on his stomach, bargaining with God not to throw up during attendance. Fluorescent lights. A whiteboard. A water bottle that is not helping. Classmates who keep asking if they’re okay. What follows is 90 minutes of whispered bathroom sprints, fake “I’m fine” smiles, a teacher who will not stop calling on them, and the slow realization that salt water does not care about your sixth-period schedule. They drank the ocean. The ocean drank them back.
